scripts.build: pnpm --filter @paperjsx/license build && pnpm --filter @paperjsx/pvce build && pnpm --filter @paperjsx/document-diff build && pnpm --filter @paperjsx/protocol build && pnpm --filter @paperjsx/json-to-pdf build && pnpm clean && node scripts/build-free.mjs && (test -f ../../keys/public-v2.pem && node scripts/build-pro.mjs || echo 'Skipping pro build (no keys)')
scripts.build:free: pnpm --filter @paperjsx/pvce build && pnpm --filter @paperjsx/protocol build && rm -rf dist && node scripts/build-free.mjs
scripts.build:pro: pnpm --filter @paperjsx/license build && pnpm --filter @paperjsx/pvce build && rm -rf dist-pro && node scripts/build-pro.mjs
scripts.docx:level-b-gate: pnpm check:docx-validator && pnpm build && node scripts/docx-level-b-gate.mjs
scripts.docx:level-c-gate: pnpm check:docx-validator && pnpm build && pnpm docx:level-b-gate && node scripts/docx-level-c-gate.mjs
scripts.docx:level-c-gate:local: pnpm check:docx-validator && pnpm build && pnpm docx:level-b-gate && node scripts/docx-level-c-gate.mjs --allow-missing-libreoffice
scripts.docx:engine-gate: pnpm check:docx-validator && pnpm check:docx-static-gate && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm docx:byte-repro && pnpm check:source-mode && pnpm check:bundle && pnpm pack:check && pnpm check:release-candidate
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @paperjsx/pvce build && pnpm --filter @paperjsx/document-diff build && pnpm --filter @paperjsx/protocol build && pnpm --filter @paperjsx/json-to-pdf build && tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @paperjsx/pvce build && pnpm --filter @paperjsx/document-diff build && pnpm --filter @paperjsx/protocol build && vitest run
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm clean && pnpm --filter @paperjsx/license test && pnpm check:docx-validator && pnpm check:docx-static-gate && pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm docx:byte-repro && pnpm check:source-mode && pnpm check:bundle && pnpm pack:check && pnpm check:release-candidate
